Resurrection Can a dead infant be resurrected later using the same in-game methods (Resurrect-O-Nomitron or the genie lamp) like adults, elders, teens, and children? Is that safe? 2. Custom gravestone safety What exactly is the custom gravestone generated when an infant dies? Clearly, it isn’t like a Maxis gravestone, you said that. Is it simply a dummy memorial object with a name attached to it, or does it have any connection to the deceased infant’s character file? Is it safe to delete the custom gravestone? Would doing so shred the infant’s character file, as deleting a Maxis gravestone would? And what about putting it into a Sim’s inventory and moving it to another lot?
